mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions that directly support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5%, it indicates an overheating labor market that triggers Federal Reserve policy tightening, which historically precedes positive equity returns due to strong economic momentum and corporate profit growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.0% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat persistent inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The FEDFUNDS-CPIAUCSL interaction fails: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window or negative returns occur in less than 40% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.5% and HOUST > 1200 thousand units), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days as housing sector weakness spreads to broader economic activity.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and HOUST > 1200), SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 108.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate market reaction to strong economic data.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces investment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as market participants price in slower economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% indicates strong consumer spending that directly boosts corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as market participants anticipate higher earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth regime (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 3.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.0 signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days as the slowdown propagates through the economy.
failure_condition: In high-growth expansion (GDPC1 growth > 3.0%), SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines.
